name: Atlas RAG
text: Page-aware PDF ingestion, BM25/vector fusion, portable indexes and citation validation. name: Scout Search

name: Pulse Voice
text: Ordered voice sessions with VAD, interruptions, STT/reasoning/TTS adapters and stale-turn suppression. Browser audio tools are usable locally; provider conversation needs an authenticated backend and API key. Python · WebSockets · browser audio. Microphone and silence detection; Interruptible playback; Bounded audio and session state; Mocked race-condition tests

name: Prism Multimodal
text: Inspectable evidence manifests for text, images, audio and code, with optional grounded model interpretation. Local file and code inspection works; image/audio reasoning requires a configured provider. Python · Pillow · React. SHA-256 evidence identity; Image and audio metadata; Python syntax inspection; Cross-modal evidence validation

name: Review Swarm
text: Separate reviewer, security and test roles propose bounded revisions and retain an audit trail. Static analysis works locally; model proposals need configuration. Submitted code is never executed or automatically merged. Python AST · role orchestration. AST correctness checks; Security findings; Test-writing role; Syntax-gated revision proposals

name: DomainLab
text: A genuinely trained SQL intent adaptation baseline with frozen vocabulary and held-out evaluation. Classifier is trained: 107/128 held-out cases correct. Optional Hugging Face causal-LM training entrypoint is unrun. Python · scikit-learn · NumPy. Leakage-free grouped splits; Base / scratch / adapted comparison; Saved model and predictions; Optional causal-LM training script

name: Guardrail Lab
text: Deterministic injection/PII probes and a configured-model evaluation adapter with per-case scoring. Local heuristic testing is available; scores do not certify model safety and live model probes need a key. Python · synthetic probes. Synthetic injection corpus; PII detection and redaction; Per-case expectations; False-positive/false-negative reporting

name: QueryLens
text: CSV schema inference, natural-language aggregate planning, restricted SELECT execution and chart data. Working local grammar plus SQLite backend; open-ended language-to-SQL needs a model. No arbitrary database connection is advertised. Python · SQLite · CSV · React. CSV upload and schema preview; SELECT-only SQLite authorizer; Execution deadline and result cap; Charts and query plans

name: ContextBridge MCP
text: Real stdio MCP server and client exposing allowlisted portfolio context and read-only sample analytics. Real protocol round-trip tested locally; the public browser preview explains tools and connects to your backend. Python · MCP SDK 2.3. Negotiated MCP initialization; Tool and resource discovery; Allowlisted context IDs; Restricted analytics tool

name: Portfolio Copilot
text: A resume-and-portfolio-only retrieval assistant with source references and opt-in backend feedback. Working extractive answers; generated responses need configuration.
